description: Use this when the user wants bank statement to Tally XML from rows they pasted, typed or showed in a statement photo or table: "bank statement to tally entry", "tally xml format for bank statement". First convert what the user gave into transaction objects (date, narration, withdrawal or deposit, balance, optional ledger); pass raw pasted text in `text` only if you cannot. Returns Payment, Receipt and Contra vouchers against the bank ledger, keyword ledger rules with a suspense fallback, a balance check to the paisa, the vouchers XML, a ledgers XML and an Excel review sheet. Do not use when a statement file is attached (use convert_statement_to_tally); does not post into Tally or file GST.

auto_contra.description: Book ATM withdrawals and cash deposits as Contra vouchers against the cash ledger. Default true.

bank_ledger.description: Your bank ledger name exactly as in Tally, e.g. HDFC Bank A/c. Default: Bank Account.

bank_ledger_group.description: Group of the bank ledger in the ledgers file: Bank Accounts (default) or Bank OD A/c.

cash_ledger.description: Cash ledger for ATM withdrawals and cash deposits (booked as Contra), e.g. Cash. Default: Cash.

closing_balance.description: Closing balance if the file has none, e.g. 98450.00. With the opening balance it proves no row is missing.

company.description: Optional Tally company name, e.g. Sharma Traders 2026-27. Leave empty to import into the company open in Tally.

date_order.description: Order of numeric dates: DMY (default, 02/04/2026 = 2 April) or MDY. Detected from the file when a day is above 12.

group.description: Optional Tally group for the ledgers file, e.g. Indirect Expenses, Sundry Creditors, Bank Accounts.

ledger.description: Tally ledger to post matching rows to, e.g. Salary Payable.

match.description: Text to look for in the narration, case-insensitive, whole words, e.g. SALARY or AMAZON (AMAZ* matches a word start).

side.description: Optional: out (withdrawals only), in (deposits only) or both (default).

voucher_type.description: Optional: payment, receipt or contra. Use contra for transfers to your own other bank or cash account.

ledger_rules.description: Narration keyword to ledger rules, first match wins, e.g. [{"match":"SALARY","ledger":"Salary Payable"},{"match":"GST","ledger":"GST Payable"}] or text "SALARY=Salary Payable; RENT=Rent". Rows that match no rule go to the suspense ledger.

opening_balance.description: Opening balance if the file has none, e.g. 125000.50 or "1,25,000.50 Cr". Used to check the total.

statement_year.description: Year for dates printed without one, e.g. 2026, or a financial year like "FY 2026-27" (April to December 2026, January to March 2027).

suspense_ledger.description: Ledger for rows that match no rule, e.g. Suspense. Default: Suspense.

text.description: Fallback only: pasted statement text or CSV when you cannot build the objects, e.g. "02/04/2026 NEFT ACME 25,000.00 Cr 1,45,000.00".

amount.description: Alternative to withdrawal/deposit: one signed amount (money in positive, money out negative), or an amount with Dr/Cr, e.g. "4,500.00 Dr".

balance.description: Running balance after the row if shown, e.g. "1,20,500.00 Cr".

deposit.description: Deposit (credit) amount, money in, e.g. 25000. Leave empty for a withdrawal.

ledger.description: Optional Tally ledger for this row if the user said it, e.g. Office Rent. Overrides the rules.

narration.description: Narration or description as printed, e.g. NEFT-ACME TRADERS-INV 114.

ref.description: Cheque or reference number if shown, e.g. 000123 or UTR N1234.

voucher_type.description: Optional: payment, receipt or contra for this row.

withdrawal.description: Withdrawal (debit) amount, money out, e.g. 4500 or "1,25,000.00". Leave empty for a deposit.

transactions.description: The bank rows as objects in statement order, e.g. [{"date":"02/04/2026","narration":"NEFT-ACME TRADERS","deposit":"25,000.00"},{"date":"03/04/2026","narration":"ATM WDL MG ROAD","withdrawal":5000}]. Pasted statement text is also accepted.

voucher_type_names.description: Only if you renamed voucher types in Tally, e.g. {"payment":"Bank Payment","receipt":"Bank Receipt"}. Defaults: Payment, Receipt, Contra.

name: generate_tally_vouchers
title: Make Tally vouchers from transactions
